# Diamond Tip Tattoo

> Private appointment-only custom tattoo studio in Dapto, New South Wales, Australia. Realism, fine line, black & grey and custom work. Free consultation. No walk-ins.

## Studio
- Legal / trading name: Diamond Tip Tattoo (also Diamond Tip Tattooing)
- Address: Shop 5/37–39 Baan Baan Street, Dapto NSW 2530, Australia
- Phone: (02) 4261 4311 (+61 2 4261 4311)
- Email: hello@diamondtiptattoo.com
- Booking: https://www.diamondtiptattoo.com.au/#book
- Hours: Appointment only. Typically Tuesday–Saturday, mornings / from 10:00 local time. Confirm at booking.
- Parking: Street and nearby parking; near Dapto Mall
- Serves: Dapto, Wollongong, Shellharbour, Kiama, Illawarra, NSW

## Artists
- Steven Benn — owner. 31+ years. Realism, black & grey, custom, cover-ups. 80+ industry awards.
- Scotty — resident artist. 21+ years. Blackwork, linework, custom.

## Services
- Custom tattoo consultation (free, no obligation)
- Realism, fine line, black & grey, custom design, cover-ups, portraits
- Body piercing
- Studio-pickup aftercare shop (pay at studio, no shipping)

## Booking facts
- Enquiries are free. Deposit only after design and session date are confirmed in writing.
- Price depends on size, detail, placement and time; estimate given after consult.
- Complimentary touch-ups within 6 months when aftercare is followed.
- Must be 18+ with ID for tattoos.
- Reply time: 1–2 business days.
